verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these five drawbacks of a fire.

verses.pali: Acakkhusso, dubbaṇṇakaraṇo, dubbalakaraṇo, saṅgaṇikāpavaḍḍhano, tiracchānakathāpavattaniko hoti.
verses.english: It’s bad for your eyes. It’s bad for your complexion. It makes you weak. It draws in groups. And it encourages low talk.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā aggismin”ti.
verses.english: These are the five drawbacks of a fire.”
